nodes.norm_label: 1 or 0 tags: fall back to odometry aim

nodes.label: Pedro field frame + 180° rotational symmetry
nodes.rationale: Field is rotationally symmetric: blue = (144-x, 144-y, h+pi); never mirror one axis.

nodes.label: One AUTO per route, red-built and rotate180() to blue
nodes.norm_label: one auto per route, red-built and rotate180() to blue

nodes.norm_label: biobuzz package layout (shared classes, auto/, teleop/, calibration/)

nodes.label: Game rules enforced in code (G304.H, G403, G404, G407, G402, G417, G410)

nodes.rationale: Odometry, Limelight corrections and target positions must agree; AUTO pose carries into teleop.

nodes.label: RedMain Bezier control-point bug
nodes.rationale: Hand-copied red autos kept blue control points; rotate180 fixes it by construction.

nodes.label: Keep flywheel spinning all AUTO
nodes.rationale: DECODE spin-up timeouts of up to 5 s cost too much in 30 s.

nodes.label: Park deadline ~25 s with state timeouts
nodes.norm_label: park deadline ~25 s with state timeouts
nodes.rationale: A stuck intake must never cost the 5-point park.

nodes.norm_label: decode shooter pidf + idle ramp + ready band

nodes.norm_label: distance from 3d tag pose, ty fallback

nodes.norm_label: distance from 3d tag pose over ty trig
nodes.rationale: Tags are seen at steep, oblique angles.

nodes.label: Flip hysteresis (+3°)
nodes.rationale: Prevents chatter at the boundary.

nodes.label: During flip: canShoot false, FLIPPING
nodes.rationale: Camera loses the target during the spin; drive the flip from the encoder setpoint.

nodes.label: 360° flip rule past ±225°
nodes.rationale: The 90° overlap means a flip always lands well inside the range.

nodes.label: Per-frame setpoint = turretAngleAtFrameTime + tx_center + AIM_OFFSET
nodes.rationale: Don't PID on tx: the camera updates slowly with lag.

nodes.label: AUTO paths end facing the target
nodes.norm_label: auto paths end facing the target

nodes.label: Fixed-mode camera pose relative to robot center on floor
nodes.norm_label: fixed-mode camera pose relative to robot center on floor
nodes.rationale: Offset already in the Limelight camera pose, so TURRET_AXIS_OFFSET must not be subtracted again.

nodes.label: TURRET_AXIS_OFFSET (default 0,0)
nodes.rationale: Irrelevant while tags are visible; matters for odometry-only aim and MegaTag2 corrections.

nodes.label: Temporary fixed-turret chassis-aim mode
nodes.rationale: Shooter + Limelight treated as bolted to chassis; aim by turning the whole robot until turret is calibrated.

nodes.label: TEMPORARY: treat turret as FIXED
nodes.rationale: Turret not rotating yet; aim by turning the robot like DECODE, behind one switch so no rewrite is needed later.

nodes.norm_label: separate jobs: localization vs aim correction
